# GSAP 3.15.0

`gsap.min.js` and `Flip.min.js` are copied unchanged from the `gsap@3.15.0` npm package (`dist/`), released 2026-04-13.
GSAP and all its plugins are free to use, including commercially, under the GSAP Standard License: https://gsap.com/standard-license
Sideout uses them to animate players moving between courts and the queue. The app works without them; motion is skipped if they fail to load or the visitor prefers reduced motion.
